summary:
The name of this bill is the "Diploma Engineering Council Act, 2083" (Section 1, Subsection 1, Page 22). Its main purpose is to establish and operate the Diploma Engineering Council regarding managing, making scientific, quality, dignified, and transparent the diploma engineering profession or business and registering names according to the qualification of diploma engineering technicians, to enforce and monitor a code of conduct for maintaining professional accountability and quality, to regulate professional efficiency, and to maintain records of diploma engineers (Purpose and Reasons, Page 1). This Act shall come into force immediately (Section 1, Subsection 2, Page 22).

No person shall practice diploma engineering business without registering their name with the Council after one year from the date of commencement of this Act (Section 14, Page 28). A person who has obtained the qualification of a diploma engineer from an educational institution recognized by the Government of Nepal at the time of commencement of this Act must apply for name registration with the Council within six months from the date of commencement of this Act (Section 16, Subsection 2, Page 28). A person applying for name registration must submit an application to the Council in the prescribed format along with the certificate of passing diploma engineering from the educational institution, other related documents, and the prescribed fee (Section 16, Subsections 1 and 3, Page 28). A person registered with the Council must inform the Council in writing when applying for name registration or participating in an examination at the Nepal Engineering Council, and within thirty days from the date of registration with the Nepal Engineering Council, must inform the Council and return the registration certificate and identity card (Section 21, Subsections 1 and 3, Page 30). A non-Nepali citizen wishing to practice diploma engineering business within Nepal in an institution, project, or specific work must apply to the Council in the prescribed format attaching the prescribed documents and details (Section 22, Subsection 1, Page 30). A non-Nepali registered diploma engineer shall not practice diploma engineering business elsewhere other than the institution, project, subject, or work specified in the certificate (Section 22, Subsection 4, Page 31). A diploma engineering practitioner must comply with the professional code of conduct issued by the Council and must not act with bad intention, act with negligence or recklessness, or prepare or recommend false or wrong reports or reports differing from facts (Section 32, Subsections 1 and 2, Page 33-34).

The Council shall recognize the academic qualification certificates or degrees in subjects listed in the Schedule provided by educational institutions recognized by the Government of Nepal for the purpose of examinations conducted by the Council (Section 15, Page 28). For registering as a diploma engineering practitioner with the Council, the Examination Committee shall conduct examinations as prescribed at least once a year, and the curriculum and examination system of the examination shall be as prescribed (Section 18, Subsections 2 and 3, Page 29). Upon passing the examination and receiving a recommendation, the Council shall register the person's name in the register in the prescribed format, and the Registrar shall issue a name registration certificate in the prescribed format (Section 19, Subsection 2, Page 29; Section 20, Subsection 1, Page 29-30). If the qualification and experience of a non-Nepali citizen are found appropriate, their name may be registered without a registration examination in a separate register for non-Nepali diploma engineers for up to two years initially, and may be renewed for up to one year at a time on the recommendation of the concerned institution or project (Section 22, Subsections 2 and 3, Page 30-31). A person whose certificate has been cancelled shall not apply for re-registration until two years have elapsed from the date of the decision (Section 25, Subsection 1, Page 32). For technicians who have passed TSLC or equivalent in prescribed subjects and wish to register with the Council, the Council may register their names in the pre-diploma engineering register as prescribed (Section 33, Page 34).

This bill establishes the Diploma Engineering Council, whose office shall be located in the Kathmandu Valley and which shall be an autonomous body corporate with perpetual succession (Section 3, Subsections 1 and 2, Page 23; Section 4, Subsection 1, Page 23). The Council consists of a Chairperson nominated by the Government of Nepal from diploma engineers with a diploma in engineering and at least fifteen years of experience, a Vice-Chairperson nominated by the Government of Nepal from those with at least ten years of experience, the President of the Diploma Engineers Association, a Gazetted Second Class representative from the Ministry of Education and Sports, one person nominated by the Ministry from among heads of educational institutions teaching diploma engineering, three diploma engineers including at least one woman nominated by the Council, and the Registrar as member-secretary (Section 5, Subsection 1, Page 23-24). The tenure of the Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson, and nominated members shall be four years and they may be re-nominated once (Section 6, Subsection 1, Page 24). The main functions of the Council are to prepare and implement policies, plans, and programs for operating diploma engineering business, give suggestions regarding curriculum and student admissions, register names, formulate and enforce professional code of conduct, remove names from the Council for violation of code of conduct, and approve the annual budget and programs (Section 9, Page 24-25).
